service: US SEC EDGAR Filings & Insider Trading Radar (10-K/8-K/Form 4)
description: Extracts and audits official U.S. SEC EDGAR corporate filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4 Insider Trading) via data.sec.gov. Calculates governance risk scores (0-100) and generates Markdown legal/financial briefs for M&A, hedge funds, and AI RAG agents.

inputSchema.title: US SEC EDGAR Filings & Insider Trading Radar Input
inputSchema.description: Configure the Ticker or 10-digit CIK, SEC Form Type filter, and maximum filings to extract and score from the official U.S. SEC EDGAR Submissions API.

tickerOrCik.title: Stock Ticker or SEC CIK
tickerOrCik.description: Public company stock ticker (e.g., 'AAPL', 'MSFT', 'NVDA', 'TSLA', 'JPM') or 10-digit SEC Central Index Key (e.g., '0000320193').

formType.title: SEC Filing Form Type
formType.description: Filter by specific SEC regulatory form type or select ALL.

keyword.title: Document Description / Item Keyword (Optional)
keyword.description: Optional filter in primary document description or 8-K items (e.g., '5.02', '2.02', 'acquisition', 'restatement').

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of SEC EDGAR filings to extract and score (1 to 100).

accessionNumber.title: Accession Number
accessionNumber.description: Unique SEC EDGAR filing accession identifier.

companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: Official registrant entity name on file with the SEC.

formType.title: Form Type
formType.description: SEC regulatory filing form code (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, etc.).

filingDate.title: Filing Date
filingDate.description: Date the filing was accepted by SEC EDGAR (YYYY-MM-DD).

reportDate.title: Period Report Date
reportDate.description: Period of report covered by the filing (YYYY-MM-DD).

itemsSummary.title: Material Items / Description
itemsSummary.description: Reported 8-K item codes or primary filing description.

edgarDocumentUrl.title: SEC Archive URL
edgarDocumentUrl.description: Direct URL to the official filing document on sec.gov/Archives.

markdownGovernanceBrief.title: Markdown Governance & RAG Brief
markdownGovernanceBrief.description: Executive Markdown dossier ready for financial due diligence and LLM RAG ingestion.

overview.title: US SEC EDGAR Filings & Insider Radar Overview
